title: LPN: Graduate Nurses Accepted, Full Time, Per Diem, Weekends (all shifts):  7-3, 3-11, 11-7
description:
Are you a compassionate and dedicated Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) looking for a rewarding opportunity? Southport Center for Nursing and Rehabilitation is excited to welcome new team members to provide exceptional care to our residents.

Position Details:

  • Position Type: Full Time, Per Diem, Weekends (all shifts):  7-3, 3-11, 11-7
  • Experience: Preferred, but we are happy to train motivated individuals eager to learn and grow in their nursing career.

What You’ll Need:

  • A current and valid LPN license in good standing.
  • A passion for providing quality care and supporting residents’ well-being.
  • A positive attitude and willingness to be a team player.

Why Southport?

  • Be part of a supportive, dynamic team dedicated to making a difference in residents' lives.
  • Gain valuable experience and grow your nursing skills in a welcoming environment.
  • Flexible scheduling.

title: RN Supervisor, Various Shifts Available!
description:
Job Summary

The primary role of the Nurse Supervisor is to supervise the day to day nursing activities of the facility in accordance to current federal, state, and local standards.  As a nursing supervisor, you are delegated the administrative authority, responsibility,and accountability necessary for carrying out your assigned duties.

Qualifications

  • Must have be a graduate of an approved RN progam
  • Must possess a current state license
  • Must have at least 1 yr of experience in nursing administration, supervision or managerial capacity
  • Must be knowledgable of nursing and medical practices and procedures
  • Must possess leadership and supervisory ability and willingness to work
  • Must be CPR certified
  • Must be able to push, lift, pull, and move a minimum of 35 pounds with or without the aid of mechanical devices
  • Must have good organizational skills,  develop, implement, and interpret the programs, goals, objectives, policies, and procedures that are necessary for providing quality care

Job Responsibilities

  • Ensure written policies and procedures are followe
  • Cooperate with other resident services as it relates to nursing services
  • Ensure all nursing personnel are following their respective job descriptions
  • Assist with process of admitting, transferring, discharging residents as necessary
  • Monitor and assist with accident/incidents, reportable events for accuracy and completeness.  Report to Director of Nursing and Administrator.
  • Monitor new employee orientation programs for its effectiveness/submit suggesstions for improvement
  • Supervise nursing staff
  • Ensure infection control practices are maintained

Available Shifts:  ALL SHIFTS AVAILABLE
